# Pack: instance-health

Watches the instance itself (doctor, source freshness, failed ingests, automation error rates, eval trends) and keeps one issue per problem in the instance repository.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `automation` |
| Version | `0.1.0` |
| Needs a credential to publish | no |
| Okg modules it needs | none |
| Packs it needs | [`ops-record`](../packs/ops-record.md) |
